actionId.description: Capability id or exact title returned by context_actions.

item.description: File path, http(s) URL, or plain text.

tools.name: context_explain

tools.description: Invoke one capability discovered for this object. Provider acceptance is not semantic success. Callers may supply structured provider-independent verification predicates; verified postconditions establish succeeded or failed semantic outcome. Without verification, accepted remains explicitly unverified. External, destructive, and unknown actions stay awaiting_user unless confirmed is true.

actionId.description: Capability id or exact title returned by context_actions.

arguments.description: Optional provider-independent structured capability arguments. Values are strings in the current schema slice.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user confirms an action that returns CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

expectedOutput.description: Legacy exact provider-returned-text postcondition. Prefer verification for generic semantic outcomes.

item.description: File path, http(s) URL, or plain text.

verification.description: Optional caller-declared semantic postconditions. RIGHTCLICK evaluates them against observable state after invocation; provider acceptance alone is not success.

key.description: Optional key, for example an extended-attribute name.

reference.description: Optional observation reference. Currently 'before' for before/after predicates.

value.description: Optional expected or forbidden exact value.

timeoutMilliseconds.description: Optional bounded wait for observable consequences. RIGHTCLICK caps this at 60000 ms.

tools.name: context_run

tools.description: Read a context_run execution. States: started, awaiting_user, unsupported, unavailable, rejected, accepted, succeeded, failed, cancelled, unknown. Provider acceptance or a sharing completion callback does not independently verify an external outcome.
tools.name: context_run_status

tools.description: List capability providers currently reflected by RIGHTCLICK from this environment.
tools.name: context_providers
